name: City Council Meeting
minutes_text:
MISSION VIEJO MINUTES
  City Council, Community Development Agency,
  Community Development Financing Authority,
  Housing Authority, and Library Board of Trustees*

  November 21, 2011

A Regular Meeting of the City Council, the Community Development Agency, the Community
Development Financing Authority, Housing Authority, and the Library Board of Trustees of the
City of Mission Viejo, California, was called to order by Mayor Leckness at 5:01 p.m.,
on November 21, 2011, at 200 Civic Center, Mission Viejo, California.

A complete copy of the agenda for the meeting containing all items as shown herein was posted
by 5:00 p.m. on November 16, 2011, on the outdoor bulletin board at City Hall. Copies were also
posted at the Montanoso Recreation and Fitness Center, 25800 Montanoso Drive, and the
Norman P. Murray Community and Senior Center, 24932 Veterans Way.

*All Board and Agency memberships are reflected in the title "Council Member."

Present:  Council Member Kelley
  Council Member Reardon
  Council Member Schlicht
  Mayor Pro Tem Ury
  Mayor Leckness

Absent:  None

Staff Present:  Dennis Wilberg, City Manager
  William P. Curley III, City Attorney
  W. Keith Rattay, Assistant City Manager/Director of Public Services
  Cheryl Dyas, Director of Administrative Services
  Karen Hamman, City Clerk

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE: Mayor Pro Tem Ury

INVOCATION: Council Member Reardon

CLOSED SESSION

CS1. Labor Negotiations - The Council Will Provide Direction to its Labor Negotiator
  Pursuant to Government Code Section 54957 and 54957.6. The Parties to the

City Council Minutes  1  November 21, 2011
   Negotiations Are the City and City's Unrepresented Employee (Assistant City
  Manager.) The City's Negotiator is Dennis Wilberg.

RECESS TO CLOSED SESSION AND RECONVENE

At the hour of 5:03 p.m., Mayor Leckness recessed the meeting to Closed Session. The City
Council reconvened at 6:03 p.m. with all five City Council Members present.

REPORT OF CLOSED SESSION

City Attorney Bill Curley announced that the City Council considered further terms for
negotiations and provided direction to staff but there was no reportable action from Closed
Session.

PRESENTATIONS

P1.  Musical Presentation by Saddleback College Musical Theater Students

  Saddleback College Musical Theater students preformed for the City Council and
  audience.

P2.  Recognize the Top Finalists of the 9th Annual RoleAbout Theater Festival held at
  Mission Viejo High School on October 15, 2011

  Mayor Leckness presented certificates of commendation to (1) Marissa Carillo, Mission
  Viejo High School, (2) Megan Dorsey, Mission Viejo High School, (3) Kayta Ferrer,
  Mission Viejo High School, (4) Allison Gerstley, Capo Valley High School, (5) Ben
  Kimler, Mission Viejo High School, (6) Josh Lobb, Mission Viejo High School, (7)
  Kelley Moody, Mission Viejo High School, (8) KJ Mowery, Mission Viejo High School,
  and (9) Dillon Steckbauer, Mission Viejo High School.

PUBLIC COMMENTS

Stephen Wontrobski, M.V.: thanked various residents of the City for their help with an
investigation into OCFA records and he stated that he is always looking for additional help from
those who would like to type reports or conduct audits. He also provided an update on the
broker-dealer issue that he has discussed at past meetings.

Wendy Bucknum, M.V.: announced that she recently held a Neighborhood Watch meeting at her
home. She encouraged residents find out if there is a program in place in their neighborhood and
if not, to start one.

City Council Minutes  2  November 21, 2011
 Don Asay, M.V.: speaking on behalf of the Mission Viejo Activities Committee, he invited City
Council Members to the Santa’s Arrival celebration on November 27, 2011, at the civic center.
The event starts at 3:00 with games and craft booths, music and entertainment beginning at 5:00
and Santa’s arrival at 6:00 p.m.

CONSENT CALENDAR

Item 9 was removed from the Consent Calendar for separate discussion.

Motion made by Council Member Reardon, seconded by Council Member Kelley, to approve the
Consent Calendar as described below.

On roll call, said motion carried by the following vote:

AYES:  Kelley, Leckness, Reardon, Schlicht, and Ury
NOES:  None
ABSENT:  None

1.  Waive Reading of Ordinances and Resolutions

  Approved the reading by title of all ordinances and resolutions and declared that said
  titles which appear on the public agenda shall be determined to have been read by title
  and further reading waived.

2.  City Council Minutes

  Approved the Minutes for the Regular Council Meeting of November 7, 2011, as
  presented.

3.  Check Register dated October 28, 2011 in the amount of $3,071,531.93

  Ratified the accompanying check register.

4.  Check Register dated November 4, 2011 in the amount of $862,965.93

  Ratified the accompanying check register.

5.  City Treasurer’s Monthly Report for September 2011

  Received and filed.

City Council Minutes  3  November 21, 2011
 6.  Community Development Agency (CDA) Treasurer’s Monthly Report for
  September 2011

  Received and filed.

7.  Mission Viejo Community Development Financing Authority (MVCDFA)
  Treasurer’s Monthly Report for September 2011

  Received and filed.

8.  Mission Viejo Housing Authority (MVHA) Treasurer’s Monthly Report for
  September 2011

  Received and filed.

PUBLIC HEARINGS

OLD BUSINESS

NEW BUSINESS

ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR

9.  Ordinance Repealing the Requirement that City Contractors Use the E-Verify
  Program

  City Attorney Bill Curley presented the staff report.

  Motion made by Council Member Kelley, seconded by Mayor Pro Tem Ury, to table the
  item and direct staff to return, in 6 months, with an update on any new developments in
  legislation or to present the same ordinance for adoption.

  On roll call, said motion carried by the following vote:

  AYES:  Kelley, Leckness, Reardon, Schlicht, and Ury
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT: None

MAYOR’S, COMMISSION, AND COMMITTEE REPORTS

City Council Minutes  4  November 21, 2011
 10.  Orange County Fire Authority (OCFA) Report

  Council Member Kelley presented the report.

  Stephen Wontrobski, M.V.: expressed concern with OCFA’s response or lack of response
  to his requests for public records.

11.  Foothill/Eastern Transportation Corridor Agency Report

  Mayor Pro Tem Ury announced that he had nothing to report.

12.  San Joaquin Hills Transportation Corridor Agency Report

  Mayor Leckness announced that he had nothing to report.

STAFF REPORTS

City Manager’s Report

Council Member Schlicht asked if the City has the ability to accommodate tax preparers at the
Community and Senior Center this year.

City Manager Wilberg responded that there has been a lot of discussion on that topic and there
was one issue to be resolved. He noted that he would look into it and get back to the Council
with a status update.

City Attorney’s Report

City Attorney Bill Curley provided the Council with an overview on bias in relation to a
Planning Commissioner’s recent recusal before a vote on the dog park due to his potential bias.

COUNCIL MEMBER COMMENTS AND ACTIONS

13.  Council Member Reports of Events and Activities Attended

The City Council Members acknowledged their event and activities calendars as presented in the
report and agreed to provide any changes to the City Clerk for the public record.

Council Member Kelley

Council Member Kelley commended City staff, the Mayor, and all those who helped to make the

City Council Minutes  5  November 21, 2011
 Veterans Day ceremony so very special and meaningful. She outlined her attendance at the
Mission Viejo Activities Committee Gift and Goodies Boutique and encouraged residents to
mark their calendars for next year’s event. Council Member Kelley reminded the community
that Santa will arrive in Mission Viejo atop a fire engine on Sunday, November 27 at 6:00 p.m.
There will be craft booths and activities prior to Santa’s arrival, beginning at 3:00 p.m. at the
civic center. During the remaining weeks before Christmas, Santa will be in his workshop from
6:00 to 8:00 p.m. every Wednesday, Saturday and Sunday. Council Member Kelley noted that
she has a commitment and will have to leave the meeting a few minutes early.

Council Member Reardon

14.  A Written Policy to Rotate the Positions of Mayor and Mayor Pro Tempore Among
  All Council Members

  Council Member Reardon presented her report and the Council discussed the idea of
  rotation of the positions of Mayor and Mayor Pro Tem.

  The following submitted a written comment in opposition to the recommended action:
  Joyce Saltzgiver, M.V.

  Motion made by Council Member Reardon, seconded by Council Member Schlicht, to
  direct staff to craft a Council policy that will ensure each elected Council member, at the
  Council member’s discretion, has the opportunity to serve in the positions of Mayor and
  Mayor Pro Tem.

  On roll call, said motion failed by the following vote:

  AYES:  Reardon and Schlicht
  NOES:  Kelley, Leckness and Ury
  ABSENT: None

  Council Member Kelley departed at 7:26 p.m.

  Council Member Reardon announced that she attended the City’s Veterans Day
  ceremony and it was awe inspiring. She thanked staff for doing a marvelous job. Council
  Member Reardon also outlined her attendance at the Elks club Veterans ceremony and
  she recommended that her colleagues visit the Potocki Center to learn about the Outta
  Bounds program so that they have the knowledge to make decisions about the future use
  of the Potocki Center. She thanked staff, her colleagues and the residents for supporting
  her this year and she wished everyone a wonderful Thanksgiving.

City Council Minutes  6  November 21, 2011
 Council Member Schlicht

Council Member Schlicht stated that the Veteran’s Day ceremony was different this year because
the politicians stepped aside and it was basically the Veterans telling their stories. She noted that
veterans are the ones who are asked to do a job, they get it done, and they make this a better
country. Council Member Schlicht wished everyone a happy Thanksgiving to include delicious
food with treasured friends and family.

Mayor Pro Tem Ury

Mayor Pro Tem Ury reiterated comments on the Veteran’s Day ceremony and he wished
everyone a great Thanksgiving.

Mayor Leckness

Mayor Leckness outlined his attendance at the Canyon Crest Garden Club meeting and he stated
that he also had a powerful experience attending the Newhart Middle School Geography Bee.
He quizzed his colleagues with questions from the student’s championship round.

ADJOURNMENT

At the hour of 7:34 p.m., with no further business to come before the City Council at this session,
Mayor Leckness adjourned the meeting in memory of Tom Yott, to Monday, December 5, 2011,
at 5:00 p.m.

__________________________________________
Karen Hamman, City Clerk

Approved at the meeting of December 5, 2011

City Council Minutes  7  November 21, 2011
